arrange_irrigation: Arrange supplemental irrigation or sow earlier
check_drainage: Check drainage and keep field channels open before heavy rain
rotate_family: Rotate to a different crop family; expect higher fertilizer and pest-control cost
shift_planting: Shift the planting date so flowering avoids the hottest weeks
test_soil: Test the soil or ask the officer about liming and drainage
check_price: Check the current price with local buyers before deciding
check_overlap: Check that the crop finishes before the next season starts
check_water_quality: Test the irrigation water for salt before sowing
cover_bare_soil: Keep the field covered between crops to protect the soil
